name: liquibase
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "5.0.4"

package:
  name: liquibase
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/liquibase/liquibase/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 9823dbe9258ac1ab6e3dba5c24a219cca0f164f580ea4a26aedc513861bf5fa4
    patches:
      - windows-find.patch

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  script:
    interpreter: brush
    file: build.sh

requirements:
  build:
    - brush
    - maven
    - openjdk 17.*
    - uutils-coreutils
  run:
    - openjdk >=17

tests:
  - package_contents:
      files:
        exists:
          - bin/liquibase
          - Scripts/liquibase.bat
          - share/liquibase/internal/lib/liquibase-core.jar
          - share/liquibase/internal/lib/h2.jar
          - share/liquibase/LICENSE.txt
        not_exists:
          - share/liquibase/internal/**/liquibase-commercial*.jar
          - share/liquibase/internal/**/liquibase-checks.jar
  - requirements:
      run:
        - openjdk 17.*
        - ripgrep
    files:
      recipe:
        - test-changelog.sql
    script:
      env:
        LIQUIBASE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED: "false"
      content:
        - 'liquibase --version | rg --crlf --fixed-strings --line-regexp "Liquibase Version: ${{ version }}"'
        - 'liquibase --help | rg --fixed-strings "Usage: liquibase"'
        - >-
          liquibase --url="jdbc:h2:./testdb" --username=sa --password= --changelog-file=test-changelog.sql validate 2>&1
          | rg --crlf --fixed-strings --line-regexp "No validation errors found."
        - >-
          liquibase --url="jdbc:h2:./testdb" --username=sa --password= --changelog-file=test-changelog.sql update 2>&1
          | rg --fixed-strings "Liquibase: Update has been successful."
        - >-
          liquibase --url="jdbc:h2:./testdb" --username=sa --password= --changelog-file=test-changelog.sql update 2>&1
          | rg --crlf --fixed-strings --line-regexp "Database is up to date, no changesets to execute"

about:
  homepage: https://www.liquibase.org/
  summary: Database schema change management and migration tool
  description: |
    Liquibase tracks, versions, and deploys database changes using SQL, XML,
    YAML, or JSON changelogs. This package provides the community CLI and
    requires Java 17 or newer. Liquibase 5 is licensed under the Functional
    Source License, which restricts competing uses.
  license: FSL-1.1-ALv2
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - liquibase-dist/src/main/archive/licenses/oss/
  documentation: https://docs.liquibase.com/
  repository: https://github.com/liquibase/liquibase

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - dhirschfeld
